experiences.title: Ph.D Researcher in Klaus Tschira Lab
experiences.subtitle: Chinese Academy of Sciences - Max Planck Partner Institute of Computational Biology . Full-time
experiences.caption: Sep 2008 - Jun 2013 · 4 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
I work on gene sequence and structure based physical/statistical modeling on single/multiple molecule systems such as linear polypeptide and a high performance biomaterial — spider silk. 
My work partially explained the underlying designing principle employed by natural evolution that gives rise to silk's superior strength. 
I also contribute to the development of time resolved force distribution analysis theory and software. This algorithm was proved extremely useful when applied to the study of the structure dynamics simulation of spider silk's crystalline region, which shares striking similarities to beta-amyloid, the protein that's responsible for Alzheimer's Disease.
My research was done in close collaboration with Leipzig University (Germany).

description.text:
This is the second Direct To Consumer Genetic Test I helped developing and bringing to the market in my career. It provides its user actionable health insight about over 50 tumor and non-tumor diseases, that collectively contribute to more than 80% of the total diseases fatality globally, thus having huge impact on people's life quality and expectancy.
 
I led the data scientists, software architect, programmers and testers in the developing and testing of this product end-to-end, from the genetic lab to data system backend to the user front-end (mobile Apps and fully automated reports).

I also leveraged my computational biology expertise to work closely with product managers and medical doctors to ensure the prudent choice of SNPs in the quantified genetic risk calculation model; a scientific yet engaging data visualization and user experience; informative but accessible result interpretation for consumers.

It is a website that aggregates and displays realtime and historical Air Quality Index data for Chinese cities. I am not an expert of environmental issues, but I am an expert of data analysis. The ultimate interest of CAQI is to demonstrate a quantified, data driven and as unbiased as possible approach to the interpretation of air quality conditions. And hopefully the insight gained will also be found useful to residents of major Chinese cities. As its founder I was interviewed by Deutsche Welle.
